story.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Security Enterprise Tool — Falls Short of Mythos-Level Capabilities
story.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Security, an AI-powered vulnerability scanner built on its Opus 4.7 model, aimed at enterprise customers seeking automated cybersecurity tools. The product was released weeks after the Mythos zero-day threat triggered global alarm, but Anthropic has confirmed it does not carry Mythos-level offensive capabilities. Indian enterprises and CERT-In had been assessing exposure risks from Mythos, making this product launch directly relevant to India's cybersecurity posture.
